detail: Full summary: Calibration incompleteness: ascii_space keeps the proven ratio 1.0 because the whitespace-only corpus document is refused by count-tokens, and whitespace is ~15% of briefing bytes; a corpus document ≥80% whitespace but not blank would let a second calibration run land near 0.28 tokens/byte instead of 0.42.
